back2basics.text: Monetary policy involves tools used by central banks to regulate money supply and interest rates to achieve economic objectives like controlling inflation and supporting growth. The Variable Rate Repo auction is a liquidity adjustment facility where the central bank borrows funds from banks at variable rates to manage short-term liquidity. Government securities auctions are a method for governments to raise funds by issuing debt instruments to investors, influencing fiscal deficit and interest rates.

2026-10-20-am-e341e9536b.deck: On October 19, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) conducted a 7-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction and multiple State Government Securities (SGS) auctions.
